label: Claude Code
prereq: Python project with pytest, git, and uv
initNote: In your project folder, run guard init --yes. This builds the test graph, which can take a few minutes on large projects.
restart: Restart Claude Code in that folder.
expected:
──────────────────────── Guard Doctor Diagnostic Report ────────────────────────
Subsystem Checks:
  environment   PASS   Python 3.10+, guard v0.1.2 (binary: guard)
  backend       PASS   Backend 'server' is healthy (localhost:6379)
  graph         PASS   Graph has 393 functions, 1,038 tests, 22,015 coverage edges
  freshness     PASS   Graph is fresh at commit 822d265
  target_repo   PASS   Target environment verified with pytest and pytest-cov
  integrations  PASS   Integrations verified for claude (AGENTS.md and .gitignore present)
  hook_timeout  PASS   Hook timeout is configured to 180s.
Result: 7 passed, 0 warnings, 0 failures

writes.description: Stop hook command (guard hook stop) with exit code 2 on test failure
Injects Guard verification instructions so agents test before finishing
Adds .guard/ to keep local database state and caches uncommitted
Local graph storage, session records, and test run cache

coverageNote: --yes may automatically install pytest-cov into your virtual environment if coverage profiling is missing.
platformLimit: Embedded database needs Python 3.12+, Linux glibc 2.39+ or macOS 15+. Otherwise Guard uses Docker.
alternative: Alternative: permanent install via pipx (`pipx install guard-cli`).

label: Antigravity
prereq: Python project with pytest, git, and uv
initNote: In your project folder, run guard init --yes --agents antigravity to index code and configure hooks.
restart: Quit Antigravity and reopen your workspace.
